en.headline: Hong Kong Performing Arts Expo continues with Monday showcases
en.dek: The second edition of HKPAX runs through 13 October with international and local performances, including dance and drama pieces today at East Kowloon Cultural Centre, Tai Kwun and Fringe Club.
body: The Hong Kong Performing Arts Expo, organised by the Hong Kong Arts Development Council, continues on Monday as part of its second edition from 9 to 13 October under the theme Passion in Motion.

Programme listings on the official HKPAX site show several showcases scheduled for the day, including Pa | Ethos by the City Contemporary Dance Company at The Lab of the East Kowloon Cultural Centre at 17:00, Paradisum by Recirquel Cirque Danse by Bence Vági at The Hall of the same venue at 14:00, Where is the Buried Dog? by Wary Mary Theatre at Fringe Underground of the Hong Kong Fringe Club at 17:00, and The City of Others by Sankofa Danzafro at JC Cube of Tai Kwun at 20:30.

Most sessions require a standard or student pass, according to the organisers. The expo brings together international companies and local groups for performances, pitches and professional exchanges across venues including the East Kowloon Cultural Centre, Hong Kong Cultural Centre and West Kowloon facilities.

zh.headline: 香港演藝博覽周一繼續 多場國際及本地演出
zh.dek: 第二屆香港演藝博覽延續至10月13日，周一有舞蹈及戲劇節目於東九文化中心、大館及藝穗會上演。
body: 由香港藝術發展局籌辦的香港演藝博覽，第二屆以「演藝躍動」為主題，於10月9日至13日舉行，周一繼續有多場節目。

根據官方節目表，當日演出包括城市當代舞蹈團的《Pa | Ethos》，下午5時在東九文化中心形館；匈牙利Recirquel Cirque Danse by Bence Vági的《天境重生 Paradisum》，下午2時在東九文化中心劇院；波蘭Wary Mary Theatre的《Where is the Buried Dog?》，下午5時在藝穗會藝穗地下；以及哥倫比亞Sankofa Danzafro的《The City of Others》，晚上8時30分在大館賽馬會立方。
大會指大部分節目需持標準或學生通行證入場。博覽匯集國際及本地藝團，於東九文化中心、香港文化中心及西九龍場地進行演出、項目推介及專業交流。
